title: Sesame Adds Computer Control to Voice AI for 2027 Glass OS
summary:
Users can now control coding agents like Devin, Codex, and Claude Code entirely by voice through the October update to the Sesame app. The new version introduces a more capable voice model on iOS and Android that uses its own integrated computer to perform independent research and execute complex tasks.

The update serves as a foundation for a voice-based operating system on smart glasses scheduled for release in 2027. Brendan Iribe described the current AI as a "live thought partner" and "a new species" capable of iterating on documents and managing software agents on behalf of the user.
